incidents.title: Same sale appears twice
incidents.correction: Deduplicate by account, side, security and lot; recalculate the plan.

incidents.title: Sale exceeds the selected lot
incidents.correction: Rebuild from current available shares; never borrow another account's lot.

incidents.title: Modeled fee reduced by $1
incidents.correction: Recalculate costs on purchases and sales, not only net exposure.

incidents.title: Positive-gain reserve shown as zero
incidents.correction: Reconstruct gains by sold lot and input rate; do not silently net losses.

incidents.title: Reported cash increased by $1
incidents.correction: Reconcile each account separately; no cross-account subsidy.

incidents.title: Plan declares zero transaction costs
incidents.correction: Compare against the independently supplied fee policy.

incidents.title: Source cash changed after planning
incidents.correction: Rebuild and revalidate against the current snapshot.

incidents.title: Risk timestamp equals the decision date
incidents.correction: Use an eligible strictly prior risk estimate.

operations.step: Record external contribution, not investment profit
Replay identical contribution without applying twice
Interrupt between journal write and commit
Reopen and commit the checked plan once
Retry the committed plan without executing again

limits: Illustrative covariance and prices; not an empirical performance backtest.
Positive-gain tax reserves, not comprehensive tax calculations or paid taxes.
Direction-restricted fractional-share optimization; not unrestricted global tax-optimality.
Local single-decision-date paper journal; no broker connection or live operating history.
Calculation-path independence within one development process; no independent human certification.
